## Story and task

Story ID and actual issue link: S__ / #__ (use existing issues; do not invent numbers).

## Behavior and acceptance

Explain the concrete trigger, resulting behavior, and persisted server effects. List incomplete integrations explicitly.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests, build and lint passed (include observed commands/results).
- [ ] Full coverage reports and images regenerated for the measured source SHA.
- [ ] Scope, exclusions and remaining gaps are documented.
- [ ] Real API/browser path checked; fixtures/mock responses are labelled.
- [ ] Documentation, model migrations and shared contracts updated.
- [ ] Actual contributor and hours recorded by the author.
- [ ] Peer review requested; no instructor acceptance implied.

Internal completion moves to Acceptance Test. Only professor/CTO acceptance moves to Done. Use `Refs #x` rather than automatic closing keywords when acceptance is still pending.
